title: The Bug Hops Up
lines: A bug hops on a rug.
"Look! It has six legs," said Nan.
The bug hops up on a bag.
"Let the bug hop in a pot," said Dev.
Dev has a pot. The bug hops in!
Nan sets a lid on top.
"The bug has to be on a log," said Nan.
Dev tips the pot on the log.
The bug hops on the log. Nan and Dev look.
